summary: 10.0.36.03 Desktop Parity Post-Release Defect Resolution & UI Architecture Synchronization
highlights: 1. Sales & Purchases: Resolved sale edit line items blank issue by hydrating authoritative lines; fixed attachment download and preview extension sniffing for binary streams.
2. Quotations: Resolved quotation lines display error; enabled authority email dispatch with attachments; implemented authoritative client SheetJS export and server PDF preview.
3. Credit & Debit Notes: Order reference dropdown dynamically populated with party orders; eliminated item picker and synthesized adjustment lines matching Desktop CreditNoteRegisterController.
4. CRM & HRM Navigation: Customer & Supplier 'New Sale' and 'New Purchase' actions in drawers, tables, and 360 profiles now navigate and preselect the entity seamlessly.
5. GST Compliance: Set period dynamically and ensured live calculation and rendering across all 3 tabs (GSTR-2B, GSTR-3B, GSTR-1).
6. E-Way Bill & E-Invoice: Replaced raw buttons with canonical purple Actions dropdown menu with Part-B vehicle update, NIC JSON export, slip print, and cancellation.
7. General Ledger: Fully activated 3 tabs (Journal Vouchers, Chart of Accounts, Trial Balance) against authoritative accounting endpoints.

8. Financial Statements: Implemented Desktop-matching executive layout with 4 top KPI cards (Gross Revenue, COGS, Gross Profit, Net Operating Profit) and split Balance Sheet & Financial Health Ratios panels.
9. Accounts Aging: Upgraded Accounts Aging table to purple Actions dropdown menu with Inspect, WhatsApp Reminder, Email Statement, and Ledger drilldown.
10. Smart Operations & Automation: Fixed MasterService.getItems and OperationsService.getPurchasesPage runtime calls.
11. Settings Panels: Removed duplicate inner save buttons in Notifications and Module Activation, unifying save actions in the view header.
12. Universal Lightbox: Integrated in-app document and PDF viewer modal for rich authenticated file inspection.
